test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements about cell is correct?

options.text: Powerhouse of a cell is plastid.
Cell is a functional unit of life.
Cell membrane of a cell is hard and rigid.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Cell is a functional unit of life.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **cell** is the **basic structural, functional, and biological unit of all living organisms**. It is often referred to as the **building block of life**.
 
• All living organisms, from the smallest bacteria to the largest plants and animals, are composed of one or more cells, making it the **functional unit of life**.
 
• Cells carry out essential processes such as **metabolism, growth, reproduction, and energy transformation**.
 
• The cell theory, proposed by **Schleiden and Schwann**, states that all living organisms are made of cells and that the cell is the fundamental unit of structure and function in all organisms.
 
• The cell contains various organelles such as the **nucleus, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, and ribosomes**, which perform specialized functions to sustain life.
 
• Cells are classified into two types: **prokaryotic cells** (e.g., bacterial cells) and **eukaryotic cells** (e.g., plant and animal cells).
 
• This fundamental characteristic of cells makes them the **functional unit of life**, as they are responsible for carrying out all life processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bacterial cell contains cellulose.**__

 __
 
• Bacterial cells do not contain **cellulose**. Instead, their cell walls are made up of **peptidoglycan**, a polymer consisting of sugars and amino acids.
 
• Cellulose is a major component of the cell walls of **plants**, not bacteria.
 
 
 
• **Powerhouse of a cell is plastid.**__
 __
 
• The powerhouse of the cell is the **mitochondria**, not plastid. Mitochondria generate **ATP**, the energy currency of the cell.
 
• **Plastids**, such as chloroplasts, are involved in **photosynthesis** and other functions in plant cells but are not responsible for energy production.
 
 
 
• **Cell membrane of a cell is hard and rigid.**__
 
 
• The **cell membrane** is a **flexible and semi-permeable structure** made of a phospholipid bilayer. It is not hard and rigid.
 
• It controls the movement of substances in and out of the cell and provides structural support to the cell.
